newsitem.title: NETHERLANDS: Sharp rise in oil prices boosts Dutch PPI.
newsitem.headline: Sharp rise in oil prices boosts Dutch PPI.

text.p: Sharply higher oil prices pushed up the Dutch producer price index (PPI) for manufactured goods in October, resulting in a 3.2 percent rise year-on-year, the Central Bureau of Statistics said on Tuesday.
Export prices for oil products rose 54.1 percent on an annual basis in October, contributing to a 3.8 percent rise in overall export prices compared with October 1995.
Domestic oil product prices rose 39.3 percent compared with October 1995, contributing to a 2.5 percent year-on-year rise in domestic producer prices, the CBS said.
On a month-on-month basis, domestic producer prices rose 0.2 percent versus September while export prices rose 0.8 percent.
